title: Wide rank — 15 siblings at depth 1
description: One root with 180 tool calls, 15 subagents at depth 1 carrying 30 to 240 calls each, and 2 grandchildren. The shape the first real swarm session produced, which no corpus in this repository held: dot rows wider than their nodes, a sibling rank wider than any field, and a root whose label had to come from somewhere.
